business_summary: IRICO Group New Energy Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of solar photovoltaic glass in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It provides ultra-white embossed, AR photovoltaic, and back glass. The company was formerly known as IRICO Group Electronics Company Limited and changed its name to IRICO Group New Energy Company Limited in January 2016. IRICO Group New Energy Company Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Xianyang, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: IRICO Group New Energy Company Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 태양광 발전 유리의 연구 개발, 제조 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 초백색 엠보싱, AR 태양광, 후면 유리를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 IRICO Group Electronics Company Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2016년 1월에 IRICO Group New Energy Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. IRICO Group New Energy Company Limited는 2004년에 설립되었으며 중화인민공화국 셴양에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
